notes: The page states the programme is tuition-free ("integrated, tuition-free year of study abroad"), but no tuition fee for international students is stated for the programme itself. The DAAD page lists a semester contribution of around 350 EUR and the university page approx. 352 EUR, but these are not tuition fees. The only stated application deadline is for winter semester 2026/2027 (July 15th, 2026), not specifically for international applicants. The evidence quote "Submit application via • uni-assist • Website" names uni-assist as an application channel for all applicants, but the pages do not explicitly say that foreign-diploma applicants must submit through uni-assist. The application channel may actually be de-uni-assist-vpd if a preliminary review is required, but this is not stated in the pages.
